name: HeSays_1
short_caption: The robot lifts its right arm slightly forward with a loose fist, then gestures outward with both hands opened slightly before returning to its neutral posture.
movement_description: The robot starts in a neutral posture and begins by raising its right arm with a semi-closed fist towards the chest level. It then extends both hands slightly outward in a small, symmetrical opening gesture, tilting its head slightly upward. Finally, both arms are brought smoothly back down to the sides, returning the robot to its neutral resting position.
